name: Delhi NCR
intro: Delhi NCR mein e-rickshaw, EV scooter aur commercial fleets ki badi sankhya ki wajah se purani lithium-ion aur lead-acid batteries ka scrap volume lagatar badh raha hai.
marketContext: Yahan e-rickshaw aur last-mile delivery fleets ki demand zyada hai, isliye retired 2W/3W batteries ka supply steady rehta hai. [REPLACE: apne local research ke hisaab se details likhein]
logistics: Bade lots ke liye pickup aur weighment ki sahulat, chhote lots ke liye drop-off option. [REPLACE: real logistics info]

faqs.q: Delhi NCR mein purani EV battery ka scrap rate kaise pata karein?
faqs.a: Rate battery chemistry (LFP, NMC, Lead Acid), weight, condition aur live metal prices par depend karta hai. Hamare calculator se indicative estimate le sakte hain, final price physical inspection ke baad tay hota hai.

faqs.q: Kya battery sirf authorised recycler ko hi bechni chahiye?
faqs.a: Haan. Battery Waste Management Rules ke tahat waste batteries sirf registered/authorised recyclers aur refurbishers ko di jaani chahiye. Hum aapko verified buyers se connect karte hain.

marketContext: Yahan B2B aur commercial fleet leads zyada hoti hain, jinhe documentation (weighment slip, invoice, disposal proof) chahiye. [REPLACE: real data]
logistics: Fleet depots se bulk pickup coordination, documentation support. [REPLACE: real info]

faqs.q: Fleet operator bulk battery scrap kaise bech sakta hai?

faqs.q: Kya scrap ke saath disposal documentation milta hai?
faqs.a: Yeh buyer par depend karta hai. Compliance-focused fleets ko hum documentation dene wale registered buyers se match karte hain.

name: Noida

marketContext: Industrial units aur electronics/EV suppliers ki wajah se production scrap aur B2B lots yahan relevant hain. [REPLACE: real data]
